status_correction_20260818: Originally reported as a completed formal binding. Corrected: this artifact establishes that BGE-M3 loads and runs on this machine and records the per-head text-field choices, which is real, verified progress -- but the encoder identity itself is not yet hardened enough to call frozen. See known_gaps below. Do not wire this into zero_outcome_census.py or start materialization until those close.
scope: This freezes the encoder identity (revision/pooling/normalization) and, for each of RS/MP/MS/ME, exactly which existing text field is embedded as query vs document. It does NOT run corpus-wide embedding materialization, does not touch any paid API, and does not open the outcome lock.
known_gaps_20260818: encoder identity omits tokenizer/config hash, max_seq_length/truncation policy, dtype, and the exact torch/sentence-transformers runtime versions -- a version bump today would silently pass identity_sha256 unchanged
model_safetensors_sha256 is a copied constant, never re-verified against the actually-downloaded weights file at load time

pooling_mode='cls' is a declared field, never asserted against the live model's real Dense/pooling module config at load time (it was checked once, manually, outside this module, during the 2026-08-18 probe -- not by the module itself on every load)
BgeM3Encoder.encode hardcodes batch_size=min(32, len(texts)) regardless of text length; only tested with two short strings so far, not attested safe for long RS/MS document text on 8GB

EmbeddingSuccessCache does not validate a stored/loaded vector's length (==1024), finiteness, or L2 norm (~=1) -- its own round-trip tests used non-1024-dim vectors as valid, which should not have passed review

MP/MS/ME query_field=Target.visible_query_text is only correct for the STATIC_ZERO_OUTCOME_CENSUS (this artifact's actual scope); a FORMAL_DG_RUNTIME later needs a distinct, dynamic query built from the live current-round seeker utterance (metacom_pm.paper1.official_visibility_audit.SURFACE_B_NO_PM_IN_HARNESS_NOTE already documents this as DG's real surface-B query state) -- this artifact's per_head_text_construction.MP/MS/ME entries describe the static-census case only, not a permanent DG=N/A rule

encoder_binding.revision_shared_with: data/paper1_authority/paper1_official_rag_runtime_attestation_v1.json#local_model_binding -- same exact revision, one encoder identity project-wide, not two independently-frozen copies
encoder_binding.note: pooling_mode and normalize_embeddings were read directly off the live sentence-transformers module config during the local probe below (Dense/pooling module get_config_dict()), not assumed from documentation.

local_rtx_2070_attestation_20260818.load_seconds_note: first-run cold download; subsequent loads are local-cache reads, not re-timed here
local_rtx_2070_attestation_20260818.note: This is the first real confirmation this specific local machine (RTX 2070) can run BGE-M3; the existing official RAG attestation ran on an NVIDIA RTX A6000, a different machine, and cannot be read as covering this GPU.

RS.query_construction: Last query_preceding_turns=6 visible dialogue turns (dialogue-only v2, current-dialogue-excluded), rendered as "speaker: content" lines joined by newline. Already frozen, tested code -- this binding does not redefine it.
RS.document_construction: Same construction as query_text (preceding_turns=6, dialogue-only v2), computed once per source card at catalog-build time. Already frozen, tested code.
RS.consistency_note: Query and document use the identical construction rule (same window size, same rendering), so a query and a candidate card are always comparable text of the same shape.

MP.query_construction: The real officially-asked QA/Summary question text; None for DG (no static current-dialogue state pre-generation, B17.4 -- BGE-M3 similarity is therefore N/A for DG, same convention as the existing lexical-overlap proxy and the explicit_signals detectors).
MP.document_construction: The v6 Qwen compiler's deterministically-rendered candidate text (e.g. "Profile fact [health_condition]: ..."), already hash-bound per accepted unit.
MP.consistency_note: Same query field already used by the existing lexical_candidate_query_jaccard_ge_0_6_proxy in features/zero_outcome_census.py -- BGE-M3 is a drop-in upgrade path for that proxy, not a new text source.

MS.document_construction: Same as MP, for MS-classed accepted units.

ME.document_construction: Same as MP, for ME-classed accepted units.

cache_and_identity.fail_closed_behavior: Re-storing the same identity with a different vector raises RuntimeError rather than silently overwriting; a binding change (revision/pooling/normalization) produces a different binding_identity_sha256 and therefore never collides with prior cached vectors under the old binding.
cache_and_identity.no_budget_ledger: Embedding is local GPU compute with no metered per-call cost, unlike the Qwen compilers; no budget/authorization artifact is needed for this binding or for future materialization runs.

not_yet_done: Corpus-wide embedding materialization for RS (12169 source cards) or MP/MS/ME (2745 accepted units) -- this artifact freezes what would be embedded, not the act of embedding it at scale.
Wiring computed cosine similarity into zero_outcome_census.py to replace the lexical-Jaccard/word-overlap proxies -- the proxies remain the active features until this wiring lands and is tested.
NVIDIA NIM tokenizer provider-parity check (RS M2 freeze decision 5's other pending item) -- unrelated to this binding, still open.

Query construction for the RS atomic-move final catalog after the full 12169-card compile is re-run following the verifier fix -- this binding uses StrategySourceCard.retrieval_text, which is compile-independent, but any change to which cards exist does not require re-freezing this binding.
